## 5b. Pareto comparison per case (time, accuracy)

- MAS Pareto-dominates np.roots (no slower, and strictly more accurate or faster) on **548/558** cases; np.roots dominates MAS on **0** cases.
- On the 10 cases where np.roots is faster, its max relative error ranges 3.5e-08 … 2.3e+00 (median 4.5e-02); MAS is correctly rounded on all of them.

## 6. Efficiency at equal guarantee

The only other solver here that targets full double accuracy with a guarantee is MPSolve (certified, multiprecision). np.roots+2 Newton steps is the cheap 'polish' fix.

- vs **mpsolve**: MAS 30.7× faster (95% CI 26.8–35.8), MAS faster on 558/558 cases; mpsolve fully CR on 1/558 cases.
- vs **numpy_newton**: MAS 5.5× faster (95% CI 4.6–6.7), MAS faster on 555/558 cases; numpy_newton fully CR on 7/558 cases.
